beats.say: In nineteen ninety-nine, one cyclone killed almost ten thousand people in Odisha.
beats.caption: Odisha, 1999: 9,887 dead

beats.say: Most drowned, as the sea surged far inland.
beats.caption: Most deaths: the sea surge

beats.say: Two months later, Odisha set up its own disaster authority.
beats.caption: Dec 1999: disaster authority set up

beats.say: It built hundreds of cyclone shelters.
beats.caption: Hundreds of cyclone shelters

beats.say: In twenty thirteen, Phailin struck, the strongest to hit India since.
beats.caption: 2013: Phailin

beats.say: The order: zero casualties. Nearly a million people were moved out of its way.
beats.caption: Order: ZERO CASUALTY · 9.84 lakh moved

beats.say: Almost ten thousand, then twenty-one. But the floods that followed killed more than the storm.
beats.caption: 9,887 → 21 · floods killed more

beats.say: Odisha outran the sea. Can it outrun the floods?
beats.caption: Outran the sea. The floods?
